title: Gallop prior store record
description: One line of the append-only JSONL prior store. One record per readout. A correction is a new record carrying `supersedes`, never an edit. `expires_on` names the event that would invalidate the entry, not a date.

metric.description: Registry name of the metric the effect is on

surface.description: Where in the product the change ran

unit.description: absolute = metric units; pp = percentage points; relative = fractional lift

decision.description: What was decided: ship, no-ship, iterate, ...

conditions.description: What was true when this held: season, mix, ramp

expires_on.description: The event that would invalidate this entry

supersedes.description: id of the record this one corrects
